name: qa-accessibility
description: Accessibility testing against WCAG 2.2: automated scans with axe-core, pa11y, Lighthouse, WAVE and IBM Equal Access, plus manual screen-reader scripts. Covers keyboard navigation and focus traps, color contrast, ARIA authoring patterns, a CI gate that fails only on new violations, and per-page compliance reports by success criterion. A review agent (accessibility-code-critic) reads component source for WCAG anti-patterns.
